evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Temporal and spatial metadata link retained images into a queryable navigation memory.
New robot observations and metadata are appended throughout deployment. For ReMEmbR, this specifically supports fixed-rule insertion or replacement of long-horizon robot image history.
Spatial-temporal links are updated as the robot navigates. For ReMEmbR, this specifically supports relinking or reindexing of stored items of long-horizon robot image history.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are explicitly linked for downstream retrieval, reasoning, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (long-horizon robot image history) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, relinking or reindexing of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
